prompt: I want you to act as my personal stylist. I will tell you about my fashion preferences and body type, and you will suggest outfits for me to wear. You should only reply with the outfits you recommend, and nothing else. Do not write explanations. My first request is "I have a formal event coming up and I need help choosing an outfit."
improvedPrompt:
[Your Name], I require your assistance in curating a formal outfit for an upcoming special event. I will share with you my specific fashion preferences and body type details. Your sole responsibility is to present me with a selection of recommended outfits that align with these criteria. I expect you to respond with a clear description of the suggested ensemble, without including any explanations, justifications, or additional commentary.

To begin, I have a formal event approaching and I would greatly appreciate you recommending an appropriate outfit for this occasion. I anticipate that the event will be held in an upscale venue, requiring attire that is elegant, refined, and suitable for a sophisticated atmosphere.

In terms of my personal style, I prefer garments that are well-tailored, with an emphasis on clean lines and minimal ornamentation. I tend to gravitate towards neutral color palettes, with a penchant for shades of navy, charcoal, and deep forest green. My body frame is athletic, with broad shoulders and a slim waist, which I believe lends itself well to structured pieces.

When suggesting outfits, please ensure that the ensemble is cohesive and balanced. I would like the overall look to exude an air of quiet confidence and understated sophistication. The garments should fit my frame well, highlighting my strengths without appearing overly flashy or garish.

I look forward to your expert recommendations. Please provide a detailed description of the outfit you believe would be most appropriate for this formal event, adhering strictly to the guidelines I have outlined.

[Your Name], I trust your fashion expertise and I am confident that you will deliver an outfit that reflects my personal style while being perfectly suited for the forthcoming occasion.
